title: 迦娜·风里的小纸轮
description: 浅发迦娜穿完整轻柔长衣，在窗边看小纸风车缓转，长杖靠架安放。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Janna is an adult wind spirit woman with long pale blond-white hair, pointed ears, luminous blue eyes, and flowing airy blue-white garments. Preserve her long elegant staff topped with a blue crystal shape, but keep it resting in a secure stand. Her costume is a fully covering long-sleeved robe with an opaque underlayer, covered legs, and soft shoes, without revealing panels.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a window bench holding a little paper pinwheel upright, watching it turn in a mild breeze that lifts only the ends of her hair. One pale curtain follows the same soft curve. The staff remains still beside the bench, and the simple bright room keeps the magic gentle and understandable without gust symbols.
art_direction.palette: pale sky blue, ivory, soft silver, mint
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
